svg.title: Two self-closing hinges, animated: the door is pushed open and the coiled spring in the spring hinge winds up, then on letting go it swings the door shut; on the rising butt the door rises up the spiral ramp as it opens and its weight slides it back down and shut.

g.text: Rising butt, seen from the front
winds up as the door opens
Opening stores energy; letting go gives it back
